title: STEGOGUARD-LM: Evaluating End-to-End Protection Against LLM Covert Channels
abstract: arXiv:2611.28152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A defense that disrupts hidden messages may still provide little protection if its detector rarely triggers an intervention. We present StegoGuard-LM, a controlled framework for evaluating defenses against covert messages in large language model outputs. We examine token-rank and synonym channels, with Unicode concealment as a structural control, and track messages through detection, intervention, and recovery. Deterministic rewriting prevented full recovery of 103 of 104 synonym-encoded messages when applied unconditionally, but only one when intervention depended on a detector set to limit false alarms. In a four-round replay on a 48-response subset, an attacker selecting from a fixed catalog recovered more bits by switching channels, although paired gains were not statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. translated_title: STEGOGUARD-LM：评估针对大语言模型隐蔽信道的端到端防护
translated_abstract: 一种能够破坏隐藏消息的防御手段，如果其检测器很少触发干预，可能仍无法提供实质性保护。我们提出了 StegoGuard-LM，一个用于评估针对大语言模型输出中隐蔽消息防御的受控框架。我们考察了词元排名信道和同义词信道，并以 Unicode 隐蔽方式作为结构性对照，同时跟踪消息在检测、干预和恢复各环节的传播过程。确定性改写在无条件应用时，成功阻止了 104 条同义词编码消息中的 103 条被完全恢复；但当干预依赖于一个为限制误报而设置的检测器时，仅阻止了 1 条消息的恢复。在一个包含 48 条响应子集的四轮重放实验中，从固定目录中选择信道的攻击者通过切换信道恢复了更多比特，不过在经过多重比较校正后，成对增益在统计上并不显著。随机化改写在本初步实验中未表现出持续优势。更灵敏的检测器提高了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 StegoGuard-LM 受控评估框架，通过追踪隐蔽信道消息在检测、干预与恢复全流程中的表现，实证发现低误报检测器触发的干预几乎无法阻止隐写恢复，而无条件改写虽能阻止绝大多数消息恢复，但攻击者仍可通过切换信道部分恢复信息。
en_tdlr: This paper presents StegoGuard-LM, a controlled framework for evaluating defenses against LLM covert channels, showing that detector-triggered interventions rarely prevent message recovery, while unconditional rewriting blocks most messages yet attackers can still partially recover information by switching channels.
